title: Anthropic Claude in Real Drug Programs: 70% Shorter CAR-T Domains & Anti-Allergy IgE Disruptors
aiSystem: Claude Biology Research Agents & Claude Code (Anthropic)
whyItMatters: Across six pharma partnerships, Claude agents engineered CAR-T domains 70% shorter with 10× receptor expression, 35,000 anti-IgE allergy antibodies beating Xolair in vitro, and >10× tighter cancer leads.
summary: On October 27, 2026, Anthropic released technical reports with six life-sciences partners detailing wet-lab preclinical drug-discovery gains driven by Claude agents. At Generate:Biomedicines, six scientists directed Claude Code agents to refactor intrinsically disordered CAR-T signaling domains, producing a candidate 70% shorter than clinical standards that yielded ~10× higher T-cell surface receptor density and superior tumor-cell killing in vitro. At Divergence Labs, Claude largely autonomously designed ~35,000 dual-arm food-allergy antibodies in one month, yielding 20 IgE-disrupting hits—three dislodging cell-bound IgE more effectively than FDA-approved Xolair. At BigHat Biosciences, Claude integrated with an automated lab across 1,010 antibody variants in 10 weeks, achieving >10× tighter binding, +18 °C higher thermal stability, and >100× slower aggregation, while Enveda cut GMP review time 89% and flagged 7 missed manufacturing issues.
technicalHighlights: Generate:Biomedicines: Claude agents designed a 70% shorter CAR-T signaling domain producing ~10× higher receptor expression and stronger tumor killing in human T-cells.
Divergence Labs: ~35,000 largely autonomous Claude antibody designs yielded 3 IgE disruptors outperforming FDA-approved Xolair at dislodging cell-bound IgE in vitro.
BigHat Biosciences: closed-loop Claude + automated wet lab tested 1,010 variants in 10 weeks, achieving >10× affinity, +18 °C stability, and >100× slower aggregation.
caveats: Preclinical in-vitro and mouse-model results reported in company technical reports rather than peer-reviewed journals; none of the candidates have entered human clinical trials yet.

scoreRationale.foundational: Demonstrates frontier reasoning agents engineering intrinsically disordered immune domains and multi-objective antibodies directly inside wet-lab pipelines.
scoreRationale.ripple: Establishes a replicable agentic biotech blueprint spanning modality engineering, hit generation, lead optimization, and regulatory filings.
scoreRationale.verification: Backed by physical wet-lab assays across multiple independent biotech partners, though published as technical reports prior to peer review.
scoreRationale.velocity: Compressed multi-month antibody discovery and CAR-T design cycles into weeks across 1,000+ physical lab variants.
